# Grumpy Pixels

> Grumpy Pixels is a web design and development studio in Malaysia. We build fast, beautiful, SEO-friendly websites for growing businesses using modern frameworks such as Next.js. Tagline: "We build websites. Then we complain about them until they're great."

## Services

- Web design: custom UI/UX, mobile-first layouts, design systems
- Web development: Next.js and React builds, custom websites, Shopify storefronts
- Website revamp: redesigns, migrations, content restructuring for outdated websites
- Performance and SEO: Core Web Vitals optimization, technical SEO, speed audits

## Pricing (Malaysian Ringgit)

- Launch (RM5,000–RM10,000): custom small business website, 2–4 weeks. Custom design, mobile-first, technical SEO foundations, performance optimization.
- Grow (RM10,000–RM25,000): growth-focused website, 4–8 weeks. SEO architecture, blog and CMS, conversion optimization, analytics.
- Scale (RM25,000+): custom platforms — portals, e-commerce, dashboards, integrations. Scoped per project.
- Full guide: /pricing

## Selected work

- MAPACS ASC 2026 (event.mapacs.co): congress website for the Malaysian Association of Plastic, Aesthetic and Craniomaxillofacial Surgeons, built on Shopify with e-commerce for registration tickets and merchandise.
- PersonEdge (personedge.vercel.app): marketing site for a Kuala Lumpur creative agency, built with Next.js, Payload CMS and Neon Postgres.
